_comment: Verify's two files. The people's file (03-verify.md) is the pull request description and the person's review: everything above Ship is exported as written (core/ship/pr-body.ts), with no pictures. The agent writes Why and, when the change shows them, Diagrams and Interface; QualityLayer writes between its markers: the Code count and the security line, Done means as it ran (one line per point; the steps are read from the Plan), the checks' four stages as they ended, what changed from the Plan and Ship. The agents' file (agents/03-verify.md) holds everything the agents fix from and the judges record: what the fix round needs, Done means with its proof, the findings, the project check commands, the security review, the second opinion, the fix rounds and the judges' iterations (per round: what did not pass, and `Passed: N`), then the ship steps, the fixes during the person's review, the follow-ups, the lessons and the drafts to delete. QualityLayer creates both when Verify starts. No frontmatter. The iteration grammar is parsed by core/docs/build-log.ts.
title: required

sections.heading: Why
sections.hint: exactly one sentence: the problem it solves and what becomes possible once it ships; then one `- ` release-note line per change the user sees, none when nothing visible changes

sections.heading: Code
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section between its markers: the points that pass, the task's own commits and the security counts

sections.heading: Diagrams
sections.when: whenever the change crosses parts of the system
sections.hint: Give each Mermaid diagram of the built change a descriptive ### heading. Choose the orientation for readability and caption the detail to notice.

sections.heading: Interface
sections.hint: when the change shows a screen: each screen the Plan showed, as built, between `<!-- ql:artifact <reference> -->` and `<!-- /ql:artifact -->`

sections.heading: Done means
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes one line per Done means point as it ran, with the picture or terminal output the agents recorded, and how it ran: a scripted run or a real agent session; the steps are read from the Plan

sections.heading: Checks
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section: one line per stage (checks and security, independent review, fix rounds, recheck) as it ended, with who ran it and the result in a few words

sections.heading: Changed from the Plan
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes what left the approved Plan: files outside the cards, dependency files, amendments; one line when nothing did

sections.heading: Ship
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section: the branch, the pull request and the approval

sections.heading: For the fix round
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section: the points and tasks that fail and what each needs next, from the last judgement

sections.heading: Done means, checked
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes the agreed outcomes and evidence, with assessment counts from verdicts only

sections.heading: Findings
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section: the open review lines with their answers and the security result

sections.heading: Commands
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section: the recorded project checks, one line each

sections.heading: Security
sections.hint: ### Security and ### Security re-check blocks, each recorded by its helper

sections.heading: Second opinion
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section from reviews/verify.md

sections.heading: Fix rounds
sections.hint: QualityLayer writes this section: per round, what was fixed, and how Verify ended; the follow-ups for what lies outside the task go under it, below the markers, with their owners

sections.heading: Verification
sections.hint: the judge appends one '### Iteration N' block per run: what did not pass, with its verdict lines, and `Passed: N` for the rest

sections.heading: Ship steps
sections.hint: the branch and its target, and what stays with the release session: push, merge, deploy

sections.heading: Fixes during your review
sections.hint: what turned up while the person reviewed (a comment, a failing check, a moved base) and the fix that answered each

sections.heading: Follow-ups
sections.hint: what the reviewers noticed outside this task, each a one-line new task with its owner

sections.heading: Lessons to save
sections.hint: what this run taught, for the project's memory, one line each

sections.heading: Drafts to delete
sections.hint: the draft artifacts this task made, to delete once their models carry the change
